scenes.text: Multiplying a fraction by a whole number means several equal fractional groups; use strips to model.
Calculate 2/8 of 32. The answer is 8. One 8th of 32 is 4; multiply by 2 to get 8.
4/6 of 24 reading cards are used in a craft workshop. How many cards is that? Pause to choose and explain.
4/6 of 24 reading cards are used in a craft workshop. How many cards is that? The answer is 16. One 6th of 24 is 4; multiply by 4 to get 16.
